raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Associate – Hedge Fund Investor Services | Morgan Stanley Fund Services (via Optimum Solutions) Jan 2025 – Mar 2026 • Mumbai, India
Processed end-to-end investor transactions across the trade lifecycle — subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, and switches — for a high-volume institutional client book spanning multiple hedge fund structures, sustaining a zero-SLA-breach record for 13+ consecutive months, including through peak processing periods.
Coordinated with Middle Office, Fund Accounting, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to investigate and resolve transaction breaks and exceptions within SLA.
Supported OTC and listed securities lifecycle processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing and adherence to internal controls and operational procedures.
Monitored transaction status and escalated aged, high-priority and exception items to relevant stakeholders to minimize operational delays.
Acted as a key client-servicing point of contact, resolving complex investor and intermediary queries each month within defined SLA windows through structured root-cause analysis and clear written communication, while coordinating with Compliance, Fund Accounting, and Middle Office to drive closure and reduce recurrence.
Reviewed and validated investor onboarding documentation and regulatory standards; partnered with the KYC/AML team to introduce a checklist-driven review process that cut onboarding turnaround time by surfacing documentation gaps earlier in the cycle.
Maintained zero SLA breaches for 13+ consecutive months, including during peak-volume processing periods. • Prepared audit-ready reports and maintained accurate transaction records for institutional stakeholders • Maintained adherence to internal controls and regulatory guidelines across the transaction lifecycle by benchmarking processes against firm policy and industry regulation, escalating exceptions within SLA in partnership with Compliance, and preparing audit- ready, well-documented reports for institutional stakeholders.
